# Test fixtures

`ulm-minster.osm` is an OpenStreetMap extract of the area around Ulm Minster
(bounds 48.39654,9.98813 – 48.40006,9.99593), with editing metadata removed.

`ulm-churches.osm` holds two churches from the same city (Pauluskirche and
Sankt Georg) with their `building:part` ways and nodes only. Same source and
licence.
